[b][u]To Install:[/u][/b]
[b]1.[/b] Backup your BabyBrown Cow.xnb , BabyWhite Cow.xnb , Brown Cow.xnb and White Cow.xnb files located at Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Animals
[b]2.[/b] Download and extract files
[b]3.[/b] Put the new .xnb files where your old ones were (at the location above)
[b]4.[/b] Start up Stardew Valley and don't get bitten!
